purpose: Separate arbitrary pose-label variation from useful teacher ensemble supervision
latent_frame: First residue N/CA/C, preserving internal geometry and chirality
reference_source: Verified AFDB predicted backbones; not experimental native structures
empirical: Uniform over coarse-valid teacher samples; reference fallback if none
balanced: Uniform over valid 2-Angstrom CA-RMSD connected components, then uniform member; reference fallback if none
averaging: Never average coordinates or latent targets across conformations
model: Inherited full flow head, fixed final-layer ESMC and fixed ProteinAE
screen: One paired initialization/training seed. Identical target order, flow RNG and label RNG consumption across arms.
tuning: 64 families, three fixed samples, flow25 CFG2 decoder3; retain intermediate and final checkpoints
checkpoint_selection: Choose by mean per-family CA lDDT on 64 tuning families; report every checkpoint. Evaluate selected checkpoint on frozen48 ensemble-development panel.
expansion: Measure capacity on one H200 before four matched arms. Replicate only if decoded quality/validity and reference-state coverage gates pass.
limitations: N-terminal frame may introduce anchor sensitivity; cluster counts are not experimentally established states or equilibrium populations. Inherited training overlap remains.
test: No original34 or reserved17 ensemble confirmation scoring in this screen
